method: Inspected all 18 unretouched Minecraft ScreenshotRecorder captures in three contact sheets, with full-size before/after landscape confirmation.
observations: Opaque surfaces and entity lighting retain the same look; the floating test-pool roof also blocked skylight in the old build.
Water edges, submerged views and the interface remain continuous; refraction, rain/slime transparency and destruction particles remain visible.
Bloom remains localized to lights; lowland mist, main/upper clouds and water viewed through clouds remain correctly ordered.
Fast water, Nether and End captures showed no new artifacts.
Depth caching uses the existing RGBA16F metadata channel and retains exact central depth; half-resolution edge softening remains a practical limitation.
